exposure: poor teacher cooperation in online classes
cohort: The study included 3,571 school-going adolescents aged 10-19 years (mean age: 14.9 years) across 63 districts in Bangladesh.
finding: The prevalence of moderate to severe depression was 37.3% and anxiety was 21.7% among school-going adolescents in Bangladesh during the COVID-19 pandemic, associated with various lifestyle and behavioral factors.
